description: Phase 3 amendments to the approved 600-year design, applied by tools/research/build_research_600.py after the design branch's graph and registry. 'adopt' turns live catalog entries that TechnologyEras dated inside the window, but the design never listed, into registry items with a design year, band, foundations and pace. 'precedents' adds optional precedents to existing registry items. 'redate' sets the earliest year of live entries that stay outside the registry. Proposals: docs/research/PHASE2_*.md (undated in-window items).
